titleText: JTF News: UN News, The Guardian
mainText: President Javier Milei stated at the United Nations that Argentina will take matters into its own hands regarding the Falklands.
President Xi Jinping of China begins a state visit to Washington, where President Trump provides a planeside welcome.
Harvey Weinstein received a 15-year prison sentence for a 2006 sex assault.
President Pezeshkian of Iran addresses the UN General Assembly in 2026.
Hurricane Polo intensifies to category 5 off the coast of Mexico.
